book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu wong tambiy wei bezomb eno wo nimzalek
Yesu lek la eivek bot ti, me la nge loxalu nei me la tyip emaxow beeng qes.
Xel valu qou tambiy bezombeing ti wei xel liw lek lelek o me lam. Yesu yei xel xe wongeingis, om neil wou tambiy wei bezomb on, “A neung, wa qou laleim vevopeing. A semaleeng wa xe sewokeing veil.”
Xel putoung valu wei petieing eno xel neil wou ma en tine bei, “Tambiy tine embei qou Anutu nimbeeng!”
Yesu woulek xel xe woueing nalei me neil, “Xam ghe di wou naleimim nilul eivek laleimim enva?
Qayeeng tina inye xeiles bei a neil: ‘A semaleeng wa xe nilul,’ o a neimbei, ‘Qandi lek me la’?
Ekom inyon xam ghe boulek bei, Xomaxoneing Neu Moux wo lei ngandoung lek tembuing en semalenyeing sewokeing.” Woyom moxo neil wou tambiy wei bezomb on bei, “Qandi lek, de qou wa xe lelek me la bam.”
De moux moxo qandi lek me la beeng.
Xel qendu ngandoung on yei tine, xel etek en ingwei xel yei Anutu xe nikanzek me sanghoxe Anutu, e tiwei wong nikanzek wou xomaxoneing ti yo.
Yesu taxe Matai
Ka Yesu la nanghei inyon, moxo yei tambiy ti lei Matai toundei eivek xomek takis. Moxo neil wou e, “Betiwou ay,” om Matai qandi lek me betiwou e me la.
Kale Yesu di ya eivek Matai xe xomek, xel ngenong wei mi qou takis me xel sewokeing eno lam me di ya is e me e xe xel betiyeing.
Xel Parisi yei tine, om xel teling wou xel betiyeing, “Nambei nya xam xe putoung di ya is xel wei mi qou takis me xel wei mi wo sewokeing o?”
Yesu ngo tine me neil, “Xel wei vanei ma eno se mi la wou dokta, qe xel wei vanei yo.
Ekom xam ghe na me na qou kwa wou qayeeng tine qes:

content.text: ‘A laleing vind lalei pyaweing de a laleing se vind seing xound.’ Hosea 6:6

content: En a se lam bei taxe xel wei bombek o, qe xel wei sewokeing o.”
Yesu luk en kwa wei vambueing yaeing o
Woyom Yoan xe xel betiyeing lam me teling wou Yesu, “Nambei nya ekom xa is xel Parisi mi vambu yaeing, de wa xe xel betiyeing se mi vambu yaeing?”

Yesu neil elox bei, “Nambei nya xel wei lam en iingama eno na qou laleind maying gyeik tambiy wei embei dii vex eno nanghei toundei is xel? Ka bouk wei xel embei qou tambiy wei iingama yo me na veil xel, woyom tyek xel vambu yaeing.
“Tambiy ti se mi qou qaeing vako myasepu me duw eivek teimb takwei, en qaeing vako wei xel duw on tyek tetei me zex teimb on bo nilul.

Xel ti se mi taw wain vako eivek wain takwei ninavi. Wangwei xel bong ambei nyon nei, wain ninavi yon tyek na tip, de wain on tyek na taw veil de ninavi yon tyek bo nol. Qe xel mi taw wain vako yon eivek ninavi vako, me luw xouing tyek mendei nimza.”
Yesu piyexe vexawo wei mey o de wo vex wei vanei yo wo nimzalek
Ka moxo neil qayeeng tine, gyovaxa ti lam me ev vaxakatu eivek wou e tax me neil, “A neung vex mouk mey. Ekom wang nam a ni memam lek e, en vexo e mendei mapieing no.”
Yesu qandi lek me la is e, me e xe betiyeing is ambei nyon.
De woyom vex tiwei mi qou gyand teyei lek vakovek qes xoumeeng yuw eno lam me di la yus en e me axlek e xe teimb ding on myasepu.
Vexo neil wou xow, “Wangwei a mou daxlek e xe teimb, on tyek a bo nimzalek.”
Yesu pekwi me yei vex on me neil, “A neung vex, wa laleim embo nimza, wa xe wongeingis wong wang wo nimzalek.” Om vexo wo nimzalek gyeik kayon.
Yesu la eivek gyovaxa xe xomek me yei xel wei di vei sakwep me wo talot me yei xel qendu yon di wo nindenduing,
moxo neil, “Xam la veil. Vexawo ne se mey qe di yeip.” Ekom xel napexe e.
Ka Yesu tiy xel qendu ngandoung on la myayaing, moxo la lalei me zeim vex on mema, de vexo qandi lek.
Qayeeng la wo ngandoung en tine eivek tembuing danghei danghei nei dalus.
Yesu wong matekeing yayuw me myatueing ti wo nimza lek
Ka Yesu la nanghei inyon me la, tambiy matekeing yayuw betiwou e, me di taxe la wou e, “Dawit Neu Moux,
pyanaleim en uw!”
Moxo la eivek xomek, eno tambiy yuw wei mend tekeing o lam wou e, me moxo teling luw, “Muw ghe wongis bei a teyei bei bong tine?” Luw lewexe, “Ee, Tambiy Ngandoung.”
Woyom moxo toung mema lek luw mendghalus me neil, “Muw ghe wongis om lul tine e na teyei lek wou muw.”
De luw mendghalus yeila. Yesu peti luw, “Kandek muw seng bong xelti boulek lul tine.”
Ekom luw la myayaing nei me teyoxe qayeeng on lala en Yesu eivek tembuing danghei danghei dalus tiyon.
Ka luw la veil, xomaxoneing qou tambiy ti myatueing wei memo dei eivek me se teyei bei baluk o me lam wou Yesu.
Me gyeik Yesu tiy memo yon la myayaing, tambiy wei myatu yon luk. Xel qendu ngandoung on etek me neil, “Lulti nambei tine eno xelti se mi yei eivek Israel ti.”
Ekom xel Parisi neil, “Moxo mi tiy xel angya nikanzek wei gyovaxa lukanzek wei xel memo yo.”
Xel xukxe yon nuyuka
Yesu mi la eivek beyeeng nayak dalus me beyeeng me teyoxe xel eivek xomek qekueing ama wei xel Yuda yo me neil Xoulek Nimza wei tete lalei yo me wong xel wei vanei leimalei eno mi wo nimzalek.
Gyeik ingwei yei xel qendu ngandoung on, moxo pyanalei en xel, en nambei xel lundpeyei yon la bandabanda, me xel mindei e wo nol nambei sipsip wei gyovaxa ma veil o.
Woyom moxo neil wou e xe xel betiyeing, “Neing zuw ngenong ekom xel xukxe yon nuyuw ka.
Om xam teling wou xuk ma bei e bong xel xukxe na eivek e xe xuk me na qou neing eivek xuk.”

footnotes.text: Qayeeng tine, “Dawit Neu Moux”, qes nge nambei nye Mesia.
